========================================
 RIL (Radio Interface Layer) Test Usage
========================================

This document provides instructions on how to configure the environment and execute the RIL test script (run_testcase.sh).


1. Configuration and Build
--------------------------

Before running the test script, the build configuration must be modified and the project must be recompiled.

1. Disable the OFONO Feature
   In the project configuration, find and disable the CONFIG_OFONO option.

2. Enable the RIL Test Feature
   In the project configuration, find and enable the CONFIG_RIL_TEST option.

3. Clean and Recompile
   Perform a full clean of the build (e.g., distclean) and then recompile the entire project.


2. Deployment and Execution
--------------------------

After the build is complete, follow these steps to push the script to the target device and execute it.

1. Push the Script to the Device
   Use the adb command to push the test script, run_testcase.sh, to the /data directory on the target device.

   adb push run_testcase.sh /data/

2. Execute the Test Script
   Connect to the device via adb shell and use the sh command to execute the script.

   adb shell "sh /data/run_testcase.sh"


3. Adding New Test Cases
--------------------------

To add a new test case, please edit the `ril_parcel_ctor_verifier.cpp` file. New entries should be added to the `cases` array.

Please use the existing entries in the array as a reference for the correct format and structure.
